members.name: James
members.bio: James leads Trash Dash from its first wild idea to the finished journey. He keeps story, play, art, and sound pointed at one promise, and makes the calls that help the whole team move together.
members.background: A welcoming production hub connecting story, levels, characters, effects, and music through planning cards, world maps, models, and overview screens.

members.name: Emily
members.bio: Emily designs climaxes that test what the player learned and reveal what the opponent cares about. Her bosses enter with personality, fight fairly, and leave consequences behind.
members.background: A dramatic but welcoming boss room with an arena map, creature silhouettes, and red-violet practical light.

members.name: Matilda
members.bio: Matilda catches the funny, heartfelt truths adults can miss. She gives every character a reason to speak, lets discoveries happen in front of the player, and knows when a quiet moment deserves room.
members.background: A cozy story room with an open notebook, abstract beat cards, woodland keepsakes, and warm lamplight.

members.name: Ramona
members.bio: Ramona hears the bounce in a run, the hush after a hard moment, and the tune a boss was hiding all along. She keeps the soundtrack playful, brave, and full of room for the game to speak.
members.background: A cozy music studio with keyboard, percussion, glowing waveform shapes, and warm amber light.

website_roster_note: Owner-directed website roster: James, Emily, Matilda, and Ramona only. Their roles and biographies retain the approved game-credit wording.
